gloss: to report, contact, and consult (workplace communication principle)

definitions.explanation: To practice the three-part workplace communication principle of reporting progress, contacting relevant parties, and consulting before making decisions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかりして→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please make sure to report, contact, and consult properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新入社員|しんにゅうしゃいん}→新入社員：15536_shinnyuushain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}える→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: We teach new employees the importance of reporting, contacting, and consulting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}った→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Because proper reporting was neglected, the problem grew bigger.

notes:
An acronym of ⟦{報告|ほうこく}→報告：03618_houkoku⟧ (reporting) + ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧ (contacting) + ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (consulting), punning on ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach). Coined in the 1980s as a mnemonic for fundamental workplace communication skills. One of the first things taught to new employees in Japanese companies. The concept emphasizes keeping superiors informed, sharing information with colleagues, and seeking advice before acting independently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to thoroughly practice reporting-contacting-consulting
- ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧: reporting-contacting-consulting is important
- ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}る→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧: to neglect proper communication

CULTURAL NOTE:
This is a cornerstone concept of Japanese business culture. Failure to practice ⟦{報連相|ほうれんそう}→報連相：12109_hourensou⟧ is considered a serious professional failing. The wordplay with ⟦ほうれん{草|そう}→ほうれん草：05188_hourensou⟧ (spinach) makes it easy to remember and is often referenced humorously in workplace training materials.
